info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Currents-v1-spec
info.description: The Current Weather Alerts API provides real-time updates on severe weather alerts for various regions. This endpoint allows users to access the latest alerts issued by meteorological authorities, ensuring they stay informed about potentially dangerous weather conditions. Typical consumers of this API include weather applications, emergency management systems, and public safety organizations that require timely information to protect communities. By integrating this API, developers can enhance their applications with critical weather data to facilitate proactive decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the most recent alerts that are currently active. It provides information on alerts that may be relevant to the user or system at the moment.
